additional_concerns: Footnote 5 repeats demonstration without an express request condition, supporting a rival unconditional reading. PRESERVES below applies only to the expressly selected request-conditioned reading; it does not resolve that alternative or the reach of the high-confidence qualification.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED denotes satisfaction of the request condition only. Neither Boolean outcome establishes fulfillment, SFC acceptance, adequate supervision, soundness or proper ownership records. Confirmation and underlying duties continue without a demonstration request.
Paragraphs 15 and 16 have their own applicable request conditions; a paragraph 14 demonstration request does not automatically activate audit, verification or legal-opinion duties.

The supplied register provisions, valuation supervision provision and intermediary provisions concern distinct actors, activities or duties. They do not add conditions to this demonstration trigger or establish a general fulfillment test. The referenced Appendix factors and complete paragraphs 10–13 would be needed for a fuller assessment of substantive compliance, but are not necessary to compute this narrowly specified trigger.

authority.rationale: The supplied paragraph 10 and footnote 1 establish the allocation of responsibility without additional external authority. Assessing substantive fulfillment would require a separate inquiry.

executable_correspondence.rationale: Continuing ultimate responsibility is not a condition determining whether an applicable paragraph 14 request exists. Its absence from this trigger formula is not an omission relative to the typed question.

question_relation.rationale: This duty continues independently of an SFC demonstration request. It concerns underlying responsibility, not activation of the demonstration duty, even though compliance may form part of the eventual demonstration.

source_support.rationale: Paragraph 10 expressly retains ultimate responsibility for management and operational soundness regardless of outsourcing; footnote 1 reinforces full responsibility. This establishes responsibility, not proof of fulfillment.

authority.rationale: The supplied paragraph 14 and footnote 5 suffice to assess this expressly conditional reading. No additional external authority is necessary for the limited trigger comparison; the interpretive alternative remains unresolved.

executable_correspondence.rationale: Within the supplied in-scope classification, the result is exactly whether an applicable demonstration request exists. This preserves activation under the selected reading, without testing performance, satisfaction or minimum demonstration content. Unknown facts remain unknown; the classifications themselves are supplied judgments.

followup_questions: Should footnote 5 be read solely as specifying paragraph 14's minimum demonstration content, or as imposing demonstration independently of a request?
Does the high-confidence qualification apply only to absence of smart-contract vulnerabilities and security flaws, or also to compliance with paragraphs 10–13?

question_relation.rationale: The claim supplies the request condition whose activation the question asks about. The question explicitly selects the reading that footnote 5 supplies content without removing that condition.

source_support.rationale: Paragraph 14 expressly requires demonstration upon request of the specified matters to SFC satisfaction. Footnote 5 adds minimum content. Its unconditioned repetition of demonstration leaves a rival reading open, but does not negate the supported duty upon request or establish that request is the sole trigger under every reading.
